body.objective: Add exact finite-order resonant normal-form and multiple-scale machinery that distinguishes removable secular terms, frequency/parameter renormalization and genuine resonant cokernel obstructions. The immediate consumers are sf:program/work/bridge-global-bounded-cone-real-zero-locus, sf:program/work/bridge-harmonic-sign-resonance-join and sf:program/work/black-hole-asymptotic-metric-reconstruction-all-orders. Paper 13 currently classifies exponential-polynomial versus bounded corrections fixture by fixture; Conflux needs a canonical structure that can recognize when many polynomial-growth coefficients arise from one resonant normal-form mechanism.
body.stop_condition: For finite polynomial/vector-field or constant-coefficient differential systems with exact/algebraic spectra, construct Poincare-Dulac normal forms through declared order, homological operators and resonant projectors, near-identity transformations, amplitude/slow-time equations, Poincare-Lindstedt frequency shifts and polynomial-growth ledgers. Treat semisimple and Jordan linear parts, conjugate modes, parameter variations and symmetry constraints. Return exact witnesses identifying each term as removable, renormalizable or resonant, plus an UNDECIDED boundary when convergence or infinite-dimensional control is required. Reproduce the circumference-frequency derivative secular term, the exceptional axial-polar mixed resonance after moment-map cancellation, and one repeated-root Schwarzschild formal asymptotic fixture. Independently substitute the normal-form transformation into the original finite-order equations. Export resonance lattices, homological kernels and amplitude equations to Conflux so it can generalize patterns without calling a finite normal form stability.
body.forbid: no finite-order normal form called nonlinear stability; no secular primitive called bounded; no frequency shift inserted without a solvability witness; no diagonalizable assumption at repeated roots; no discarded exceptional harmonic or zero-frequency stratum; no numerical resonance tolerance used as exact equality; no theory-specific wave equations in lib/math
